name: galaxy-plugin
description: Use Galaxy data, tools and workflows from desktop AI assistants.

author.name: Galaxy Project from Penn State University, Johns Hopkins University, Moffitt Cancer Center, and Cleveland Clinic

interface.longDescription: Plan, run, verify, and document Galaxy analyses, and manage authorized sites through a connected Galaxy MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Galaxy history and explain which analysis path fits these datasets.
Find a curated Galaxy workflow for this analysis and verify its outputs.
Run the appropriate Galaxy tools and produce a reproducibility summary.
